sourceObjective: This document is the working search library for the next Future Light Store catalog expansion. It is designed for US shoppers and for a clean, family-safe store mix across everyday utility, style, care, gifts, hobbies, and safe electronics accessories. Search terms are intentionally product-led so DSers results can be reviewed against actual images, stock, supplier cost, and variant clarity before import.
sourcePlanningNote: The current Shopify catalog boundary leaves 679 planning slots before the 3,000-product target. The allocation below is a planning ceiling, not a promise to import every result. Quality gates may reduce the final count.
sourceOperatingBoundary: Operating boundary: add only family-store products with stock ≥200, no batteries, no portable chargers, no logic boards, no adult/erotic products, and no replacement/repair parts. Keep existing Shopify products out of new batches.
sourceReferenceNote: The library follows current ecommerce discovery guidance: product-led category selection, clear product facts, structured-data alignment and answer-ready copy. Sources used for trend/category orientation and search presentation:

hardExclusions.description: Batteries, rechargeable cells, power banks, portable chargers, battery packs, and products whose core function depends on an unverified battery.
Logic boards, bare boards, replacement boards, repair parts, spare assemblies, and products marketed for device repair.
Medical devices, diagnostic claims, supplements, ingestibles, medication, and cosmetic treatment or guaranteed-outcome claims.
Adult, erotic, sexual-wellness, fetish, weapon, or tactical-weapon products.
Counterfeit/trademark-infringing merchandise or licensed-character products without credible licensing evidence.
Missing supplier cost or plausible US price, or unstable/unverified supplier cost.
Missing/unusable/mismatched images or unclear variant-image mapping.
Materially misleading supplier copy or unsupported claims.
Already imported duplicate or near-duplicate without meaningful differentiation.
Variant names that expose supplier SKU codes without a clear shopper-facing attribute.

dimensions.label: Evidence quality
dimensions.sourceCriterion: primary image matches the product, variants are visible, dimensions/material/use are supported, and no supplier watermark or China-focused scene dominates the listing.

dimensions.label: Store fit
dimensions.sourceCriterion: family-safe, giftable or useful, aligned with the target collection, and easy to explain in natural language.

dimensions.label: Commercial fit
dimensions.sourceCriterion: stock ≥200, stable cost, plausible US price, healthy margin after the store overhead, and no obvious commodity race-to-the-bottom.

dimensions.label: Variant clarity
dimensions.sourceCriterion: color, size, pack count or style is shopper-readable; remove codes and preserve only meaningful option structure.

dimensions.label: Content readiness
dimensions.sourceCriterion: enough verified facts for a product-specific title, description, FAQ, alt text and collection placement without inventing claims.

sourceSeoGeoAeo.title: product type first, then the differentiating material, size, use or included set. Keep it readable; remove supplier years, duplicate phrases, random brand names and SKU codes.
sourceSeoGeoAeo.description: write as a human selling the exact product. Lead with what it is, what it helps the shopper do, what is included, and the confirmed limitations. Never pad with generic “specific function identified by its handle” language.
sourceSeoGeoAeo.facts: use only verified title, image, variant, supplier specification and shipping/catalog evidence. Normalize HTML entities and duplicated fields before copy generation.
sourceSeoGeoAeo.questions: answer the shopper’s likely questions—fit, size, material, compatibility, care, included pieces and use context—without inventing certifications or performance guarantees.
sourceSeoGeoAeo.geoAeo: write concise answer-ready summaries, explicit product nouns, natural synonyms, scannable headings and clean internal links. Keep structured data aligned with the visible page.
sourceSeoGeoAeo.imageAlt: describe the actual product and meaningful variant, not a generic lifestyle scene. If an image is not product-faithful, hold the product for visual review instead of rewriting around it.

operatingSequence: Search one family at a time and keep the active filters visible: US target, stock ≥200, family-store category, no prohibited electronics or repair products.
Review primary/variant images before selection. Keep strong product images; hold or reject items where the image shows a different product, unsafe context, supplier branding or a misleading variant.
Check supplier cost, US price, stock, shipping signal and variant names. Do not import code-only options such as TK-0000007129 unless the shopper-facing attribute is also present and clear.
Check for duplicates against the existing Shopify catalog and the DSers My Products list before adding to Import List.
Add in controlled batches, then use Import Reviews and Shopify readback. Skip any item whose push result is partial, errored or mismatched.
After Shopify readback, route each product into one primary collection and optional secondary merchandising tags. Keep taxonomy and customer-facing copy synchronized.
